title: Geometry-bridge flow matching for blind rigid-motion correction in head cone-beam CT
abstract: arXiv:2611.23788v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rigid motion of a patient head during head cone-beam CT (CBCT) scan can degrade image quality and complicate recovery of accurate anatomical structures from the measured projections. We present a 3D flow-matching prior approach that learns the image changes induced by motion. Its geometry-bridge connects motion-corrupted and motion-free Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructed images of the same source volume through progressively reduced simulated motion. The forward projector's geometry derivative supplies analytic velocity targets along this path. A plug-and-play loop encompasses the learned image updates together with spline-based pose estimation, conjugate-gradient data consistency, and image total-variation regularization. Both the refined image volume and the FDK reconstructed image volume at the estimated poses are evaluated. On simulated 360-view scans from 30 held-out CQ500 patients with nominal per-component motion amplitude

translated_title: 面向头部锥束CT盲刚性运动校正的几何桥接流匹配方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.23788v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：在头部锥束CT（CBCT）扫描过程中，患者头部的刚性运动会降低图像质量，并使从测量的投影数据中恢复精确的解剖结构变得困难。我们提出了一种3D流匹配先验方法，用于学习运动引起的图像变化。其“几何桥接”机制通过逐渐减弱的模拟运动，将同一源体积的运动污染FDK（Feldkamp-Davis-Kress）重建图像与无运动FDK重建图像连接起来。前向投影器的几何导数沿该路径提供解析速度目标。一个即插即用的循环框架将学习到的图像更新与基于样条的位姿估计、共轭梯度数据一致性约束以及图像全变差正则化相结合。研究对优化后的图像体积和在估计位姿下的FDK重建图像体积均进行了评估。实验基于来自30名留出CQ500患者的模拟360视角扫描数据，名义单分量运动幅度...
tldr: 提出一种基于几何桥接的3D流匹配先验方法，结合样条位姿估计、共轭梯度数据一致性和全变差正则化的即插即用循环框架，实现头部锥束CT的盲刚性运动校正。
en_tdlr: A geometry-bridge 3D flow-matching prior combined with a plug-and-play loop of spline-based pose estimation, conjugate-gradient data consistency, and total-variation regularization enables blind rigid-motion correction in head cone-beam CT.
